The [[Jaraana irstat]] was a [[Tarasin]] tribe that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The irstat was lead by the second eldest [[Gender/Legends|female]], [[Irstat-Kes]] [[Mir'Liss]], while Mother [[Morad'Ka]], the tribes oldest female, was its spiritual leader. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] traveled to the village where the irstat lived during the Clone Wars, hoping to persuade Morad'Ka to help her release a [[T'salak|dangerous creature]] that was imprisoned beneath [[Cloud Mountain]]. Morad'Ka refused, Muun left and set fire to the village the next day. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] were able to help put out the flames.<ref name="Force Concession" />

Shortly afterward, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Almas Academy]] requested that the irstat give them permission to study the t'salak, the creature that Muun had been searching for. Morad'Ka agreed to let them and sent a message to the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nek Lawsirk]], to tell him that he could come and collect the creature. However, Lawsirk had been captured by Muun, so she disguised herself as him and traveled to the Jaraana irtsat's village, to collect the creature herself.<ref name="Force Contention">{{LivingForce|Forces of Cularin: Force Contention}}</ref>
